enrichment.headline: Approves $67.26M in payroll checks and direct deposits for July to September 2021
enrichment.summary: The board approves the district's payroll payments for the first three months of the fiscal year: 3,021 printed checks and 24,009 direct deposits. The total is $67,260,334.53 for July 1 through September 30, 2021. Details are in Exhibits 1-4 attached to the item.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Payroll Warrants and Direct Deposits— Fiscal Year 2021-2022 - July 1, 2021 - September 30, 2021 - Chief Business Officer

enrichment.headline: Approves $64.8M in accounts payable checks issued July to September 2021
enrichment.summary: The board approves the district's accounts payable payments (bills paid to vendors) for the first three months of the fiscal year. This covers 1,651 printed checks totaling $64,800,465.68 from July 1 through September 30, 2021. Details are in Exhibits 1-4 attached to the item.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Accounts Payable Warrants - Fiscal Year 2021-2022 – July 1, 2021 - September 30, 2021 - Chief Business Officer

enrichment.headline: Hires Jensen Hughes for up to $101,700 to design a new fire alarm at Hintil Kuu Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: Jensen Hughes, Inc. of Concord will design a replacement for the existing fire alarm systems at the Hintil Kuu Child Development Center, including site visits, a review of current plans and drawings and surveys. The limit of $101,700 includes a $5,000 contingency fee. Work is scheduled from November 4, 2021 to June 29, 2024.

enrichment.headline: Adds $37,628 to Viatron's contract to catalog and reorganize Cole Administration Center files
enrichment.summary: This amendment gives Viatron Systems, Inc. extra work on the Cole Administration Center Project: listing all files retrieved from district storage, building a new database log of them and putting them in alphabetical order. It adds $37,628.20, raising the contract limit from $308,795.00 to $346,423.20. All other terms stay the same.

enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Oakland REACH sets out each side's duties for REACH programming and partnership at Sojourner Truth Independent Study School. The item states no dollar amount. It covers July 21, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The agreement period began before this vote, so the board is approving it after the fact.

enrichment.summary: The board approves a resolution allowing a sole source exception to public bidding (the district skips competitive bidding because it names one provider) and a services agreement with Family Engagement Lab. The company will provide text messaging services to schools and to parents and caregivers from August 2, 2021 through June 30, 2022, for up to $200,000.
